title: Bus route · Level 3: The sharp bend
brief: The colour robot starts on the route, a black line 20 mm wide on white: fifteen 300 mm tiles in a 6 x 3 grid (about 4.2 m of line) of curves and straights with one sharp 90 degree bend, from its start 60 mm into the first tile, facing along it (starts vary 10 mm and 5 degrees); the level fixes the robot. Progress counts the route's 15 checkpoints, one across the line in each tile, the last at the route's end, each passed in order and only within 50 mm of the line, so cutting across gains nothing. The robot's middle is the middle of its axle; its distance off is to the nearest point of the route's centreline. A run ends at the last checkpoint, when the middle is more than 150 mm off the line, once the program has ended and the robot has then stood still for 0.5 s, or at 90 s. Per run: 50 for finishing (every checkpoint passed), plus up to 40 for speed (all 40 at 35 s or less, 40 x 35 / time above it), both paid only on a finish; plus 10 if the middle was never more than 50 mm off the line. Pass: mean 60 or more over 5 runs, 4 of them finished. Par time: 35 s.

score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)
